notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed bug where some players couldn't get past level 48
 Fixed bug where some players had invisible level select buttons
 Fixed bug where skipping an already completed level would uncomplete next level


Next I'm going to fix some bugs where moving the plant element too fast causes weird behaviors, and some of the weird edge case plant mixtures

notes.title: New Element & 30 New Levels!
notes.content:
It's Finally Here!

Whats New?


 The New Plant Element:

 Plants can connect to other plants and move as one!
 Plants have a unique interaction with every other element type!

 30 New handcrafted levels:

 The new levels explore all of the interesting new possibilities the plant has to offer!
 The new levels are some of the most intriguing and difficult ever seen in the game!

 New Achievement:

 "World 6" - For beating all of the new plant Levels!
 More Coming Soon!

 BugFixes and Quality of Life:

 Patched bugs from moving elements too fast
 Patched unintentional wins in some levels
 Patched broken animations in specific conditions
 you can now also undo a move with "Q" or "Z", and Reset with "R"!
 Patched some sounds breaking


That's all I have at the moment, you can go play the new levels right now. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or find any bugs!
